tool.help: *THE NEW BANDAGE: As of version 2022.09, the Bandage tool is now built on `Bandage-NG `_. It may contain new features, new bugs and otherwise be not compatible with the Bandage by Ryan Wick. The documentation, instructions, etc. might be incomplete, missed and inaccurate as well ## Table of Contents * [Intro](https://github.com/asl/BandageNG#intro) * [Help](https://github.com/asl/BandageNG#help) * [Pre-built binaries](https://github.com/asl/BandageNG#pre-built-binaries)
